story_text: As a guest, I want to create a booking with my name, room type, and dates so that I can reserve a room.

positive.title: Create a booking with all valid fields (name, room type, dates)
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Click submit

positive.title: Create a booking for the earliest available date and the latest available date
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Create a booking with today's date
4. Click submit

positive.title: Create a booking with a single night stay and multi-night stay
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Fill the date fields with a sing night date stay
4. Click submit

positive.title: Create a booking with guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Fill the guest field with number of guests
4. Click submit

positive.title: Create a booking without guests
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Keep the guests field empty
4. Click submit

negative.title: Create a booking with missing name
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Keep the name field empty
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: User is prompted that the name field is required

negative.title: Create a booking with missing room type
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Keep the room type field empty
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: User is prompted that the room type field is required

negative.title: Create a booking with missing check-in date
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Keep the check in field empty
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: User is prompted that the check-in date field is required

negative.title: Create a booking with missing check-out date
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Keep the check out field empty
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: User is prompted that the check-out date field is required

negative.title: Create a booking with a room type that does not exist
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Fill the room type field with Triple or Quadriple
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: User should be prompted with an error stating only single and double are the options

negative.title: Create a booking with check-out date before check-in date
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Fill the check-out date with an earlier date than the oe in the check-in date
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: User is prompted that the check-in date can't be after check-out date

negative.title: Create a booking on previous dates
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Fill the check-in with a date that has passed
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: User is prompted that the check-in date can't be on an old date

negative.title: create a booking with invalid date format
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Enter DD/MM/YYYY date format
4. Click submit
negative.expected_result: User is prompted with an error

edge.title: Create a booking where check-in and check-out are the same day
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Fill the check-in and the check-out dates with the same date
4. Click submit

edge.title: Create a booking with a very long guest name
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Fill the name field with 255 characters
4. Click submit

edge.title: Create a booking with special characters in guest name
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Fill the name field with special characters
4. Click submit

edge.title: Create a booking for dates far in the future
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Add a check-out date that is in the far future (e.g. A year from now)
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: User is prompted that the check-out date is incorrect

edge.title: Create a booking with two room types
steps: 1. Navigate to the create booking endpoint
2. Fill all the fields with valid data
3. Choose multiple room types
4. Click submit
edge.expected_result: User is prompted that only one type of room is allowed
